pot_confidence_interval_note: Bootstrap resamples event count and event excesses; intervals remain conditional on the selected 95th-percentile threshold and 3-day declustering rule.
pot_return_period_definition: Poisson annual-maximum exceedance probability equals 1/T; this is aligned with the GEV annual exceedance probability definition.
spatial_gev_warning: Do not interpret the notebook's spatial GEV proxy map as a fitted return-level surface. It uses a fixed shape and a scale assumed to be 20% of mean annual maxima, rather than pixel-wise fitted GEV parameters.
